Gilbert Sunday Funday Ride

Gilbert, AZ · Road · E-bike

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Gilbert Sunday Funday Ride is a road and e-bike group ride in Gilbert, AZ. It rolls every Sunday at 6:00 am from Global Bikes & E-Bikes Gilbert. About 10–15 miles, no-drop, 11–13 mph.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 11–13 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @globalbikes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Gilbert Sunday Funday Ride group ride

A short, medium-paced Sunday ride from the Gilbert shop. Regular bikes and e-bikes both welcome. The shop says plainly: 'we won't leave you behind.' Good first group ride.
